verdictRationale: Outcome 'automated_success' indicates compliance requirement is satisfied

registryEntry.label: Verify Defender Vulnerability Management Configuration
registryEntry.get_command: $scores = Get-MgSecuritySecureScore -Top 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($scores) { @{ secureScoreAvailable = $true; currentScore = $scores[0].CurrentScore; maxScore = $scores[0].MaxScore } | ConvertTo-Json } else { $null }
evidence_commands: $scores = Get-MgSecuritySecureScore -Top 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $controls = if ($scores) { $scores[0].ControlScores | Where-Object { $_.ControlName -match 'Vuln|Patch|Update|Defender' } }; @{ secureScoreAvailable = [bool]$scores; currentScore = $scores[0].CurrentScore; maxScore = $scores[0].MaxScore; vulnerabilityControls = $controls } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
